Name: Easy Fishin'
Author: Frostiverse
Description:
[b][size=6]Easy Fishin'[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Overview[/size][/b]
[size=2]This mod allows you to adjust several aspects of the fishing mini game. Configurations are included to specify which options to use.[/size]

Notes:
[list]
[*][size=2]This mod has only been tested on PC. Use at your own risk on other platforms.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=2][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url][/size]
[*][size=2]Unzip this mod's folder into Stardew Valley/Mods[/size]
[/list]
[size=2]﻿[b]Optional Step[/b] (only needed for setting configs through in-game settings menu):
﻿ Unzip [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods[/size]

[b][size=4]Configurations[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]Always Perfect - true or false; always have a perfect catch, even if you do not do too well in the fishing mini game[/size]
[*][size=2]Always Find Treasure - true or false; always find treasure when you fish[/size]
[*][size=2]Instantly Catch Fish - true or false; instantly catch fish (this will also cause treasure to be instantly caught)[/size]
[*][size=2]Instantly Catch Treasure - true or false; instantly catch treasure (if Instantly Catch Fish is false, then fish will still need to be manually caught)[/size]
[*][size=2]Infinite Bait - true or false; never run out of bait[/size]
[*][size=2]Infinite Tackle - true or false; never run out of tackle (works for both tackles on the Advanced Iridium Rod!)[/size]
[*][size=2]Auto Hook - true or false; automatically and instantly hook the trash or fish nibbling the bobber[/size]
[*][size=2]Disable Controller Vibration - true or false; disable controller vibration (only when Auto Hook is true)[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Source Code[/size][/b]
[url=https://github.com/Hunter-Chambers/StardewValleyMods/releases/tag/EasyFishin]Easy Fishin' - GitHub[/url]
